newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes slightly firmer, volumes thin.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes slightly firmer, volumes thin.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed slightly higher on Friday, supported by heavy buying on the physical Rotterdam barge market.
June gas oil settled $1.00 a tonne higher at $173.25.
A major Rotterdam refiner bought at least 60,000 tonnes of 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil on the barge market this week.
"There's rumours of a problem at the refinery and that's helped things up a bit," a broker said.
A trader for the refiner said that a combination of minor operational problems and German end user demand sparked the buying spree.
But the trader denied that that the refinery had serious production problems.
IPE trading was thin, with total volumes creeping over 3000 lots in the last few minutes of business.
July Brent also edged higher, trading 13 cents up at $19.62 at 1644 GMT.
Brokers said some investment fund buying was seen on NYMEX futures which was helping to drag the market higher.
"It's looking a bit stronger, we're seeing some fund buying coming in," said one dealer.
